examples.english: I chose three food items and two drinks as souvenirs, five items in total.

notes:
{点|てん} is a versatile counter used for points/scores and items. It also functions as a noun meaning "point" or "aspect."

COUNTER USES:
- Scores/points: 100{点|てん}を{取|と}る (to get 100 points)
- Items: {商品|しょうひん}3{点|てん} (3 items)
- Works of art: {作品|さくひん}10{点|てん} (10 works)

AS A NOUN:
- {点|てん}: a point, dot, spot
- その{点|てん}: that point/aspect
- {問題|もんだい}{点|てん}: problem point, issue

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {何|なん}{点|てん}?: How many points?
- {満点|まんてん}: perfect score
- {点数|てんすう}: score, number of points
- ～という{点|てん}で: in terms of ~
